annotations.title: Invite the person who works your leads

description: Invite the person who will work the user's leads (an assistant or a colleague) into the one seat included with Pro and Strategic at no extra cost. Use it when the user answers "Who will work your leads?" with someone else, or says things like "my assistant works my leads" or "give my colleague a login". Ask for the person's name and work email, read both back, and call this only after the user says yes: it sends that person an email with a link to set a password. They get their own login and work this account's leads with its targeting and network, so there is one list, and the account owner gets what was worked by email each week. It can never add a charge: when the included seat is already taken it sends nothing and the result says where further seats are added (Account, Team Management, where the price is shown first). Only the account owner can invite. Read the result back to the user in one or two lines.

email.description: Their work email address; the invite is sent here

name.description: First and last name of the person who will work the leads
